shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I often go hiking on weekends with my friends.
Cooking new recipes is one of my favorite hobbies.
Traveling to new places helps me learn about different cultures.
I like to listen to music while I study or work.
Spending time with family is important to me and makes me happy.
Learning new languages opens many doors for communication and understanding.
Participating in community service can be a fulfilling experience for everyone involved.
Maintaining a healthy work-life balance is essential for overall well-being and happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about learning styles.
questions: Q1: What is your preferred learning style and why?
Q2: Have you faced any challenges in adapting to different learning environments?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to understand different learning styles?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone struggling to find their learning style?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about self-management.
questions: Q1: Can you describe a time when you successfully managed your time?
Q2: What obstacles do you think people face in managing their time effectively?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of self-management in achieving goals?
Q4: What strategies would you recommend for improving self-management skills?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: What actions do you take to be environmentally conscious in your daily life?
Q2: What challenges have you encountered while trying to live sustainably?
Q3: How significant do you think environmental awareness is for future generations?
Q4: What suggestions would you give to someone wanting to become more environmentally aware?
